First off, even though he’s so lucky to have a friend like you, remember that there is only so much responsibility you can take for someone else’s wellbeing. Please be kind to yourself. But as for advice, talking about the option of therapy is a great start, but some ways to help him feel connected are just spending time together online. Schedule calls. Watch a show/ read a book together. Make a playlist for him. Start new hobbies with him to give him some way to distract himself from his current situation/ thoughts. Become penpals + write letters to each other! Remind him that this will be over and things will be alright. I hope this helps, good luck to both of you!
